_comment: The newest upstream release merged into master-play. sync-upstream.yml reads this to decide whether there is anything to do; the PR it opens bumps it, so merging the PR advances the watermark. Never key on the tag NAME alone (upstream can move a tag) — the sha is what was actually merged.
note: Merged by hand on 2026-10-09 (11 conflicts, all 'both sides added something'). DESIGN §-numbering: upstream takes one section per release (0.2.0=§25, 0.2.1=§26, 0.2.2=§27), so our own documents must claim from the tail, never §27.
